<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="xpath" initial="a">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="a1" expr="5"/>
    <data id="count" expr="0"/>
    <data id="done" expr="false()"/>
  </datamodel>
  <state id="a">
    <transition event="range" cond="$a1 > 1 && $a1 < 9 || $a1 == 0" target="b"/>
    <transition event="first" cond="$count == 1 && true()" target="b"/>
    <transition event="loud" cond="$count === 1 AND $a1 !== 2" target="b"/>
    <transition event="odd" cond="$a1 % 2 = 1 && !$done" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: xpath syntax error in `cond`: `&&` is not an XPath operator
notes: a condition that cannot be parsed raises `error.execution` and evaluates as false, so this condition can never hold
spec_references: SCXML 1.0 §5.9 Expressions
SCXML CR 2014 §C.3 The XPath Data Model

notes: a condition that cannot be parsed raises `error.execution` and evaluates as false, so this condition can never hold
diagnostics.help: XPath spells logical or as `or`; a single `|` is the node-set union
spec_references: SCXML 1.0 §5.9 Expressions
